workflows.label: Scheduled batch template creation

workflows.quote: On the right side of the page, select Create > New scheduled template.

workflows.label: Scheduled template editor permissions
workflows.quote: Choose which users can edit the template using the toggle (all user roles with access to edit batched reports or only me and account admins)

workflows.label: Automatic owner report generation and sharing
workflows.quote: Ensure the toggle for ‘Schedule and share automatically’ is on in order to be able to schedule to generate batched reports and share to owner portals automatically.

workflows.label: Report template entity selection
workflows.quote: Add entities if needed by selecting + Add entities and then Save.

workflows.label: Separate association rental owner and company report types
workflows.quote: Note: You can only choose 1 report type (associations, rentals, rental owners, or company). You cannot combine report types in the same template.

workflows.label: Scheduled batch report selection
workflows.quote: Select the reports to include by clicking + Add reports.

workflows.label: Batch report ordering
workflows.quote: Drag to reorder the reports if needed in the Selected section and then Save.

workflows.quote: Note: When you add attachments to a template, those same attachments will be included every time the batch is generated. If you need to update or change the attachments, make sure to add the new ones before the batch is scheduled to run.

workflows.label: Consolidated or separate report PDFs
workflows.quote: Choose how to export reports (Consolidated PDFs or Separate PDFs).

workflows.label: Report file ordering
workflows.quote: Define the file order if report entities are included in the template.

workflows.quote: If you have multiple properties and select multiple rental owners, the system will automatically send the appropriate reports to the correct recipients, so you don’t need to worry about every report going to every recipient.

workflows.label: Report recipient email eligibility
workflows.quote: + Add recipients to choose who you want to share the batched reports with. Important: Batched reports cannot be shared with recipients without email addresses. Select the recipients > Next.

workflows.quote: Note: These reports can only be shared to owner portals, including Board members, Association owners, and Rental owners. Recipients will automatically receive an email notifying them that the reports are available in their portals.

workflows.quote: Note: If your company is the entity, staff members will need to log in and view their reports from the Batched Reports page. They cannot be selected as recipients.
